regions.merged_text: With festival gladness we gather today, Dear old Daddy and Mother Machree, And with hearts overflowing sing homage to you On your Golden Jubilee. For fifty long years life's pathway adown, In devotion together you've trod With a tear and a smile in your eyes all the while, True as any to the "Dear Ould Sod!" In the May-time of Life, with our daily tasks o'er, We'd unite at the close of the day, Round you, then you taught us to kneel by your side, In love and thanksgiving to pray. In the world's field of battle, with hearts strong and brave, You marched, comrades faithful and true, Oh! may we, dear parents, wherever we rove- Be as loyal and steadfast as you. And may the sweet lessons of Faith, Hope and Love, That we learned, parents dear, at your knee, Be as beacons to guide us to Heaven above, While we sail over life's stormy sea. And now in the calmness of life's sunset glow, We are gathered once more round your knee, Fore'er in our hearts will burn homage and love, For you, Daddy and Mother Machree.
